skill_name: Give an example of a time when you failed to reach a goal and how you responded.
workflow: I once had the goal of launching a website in one week, but I failed to reach it. It took me several weeks longer than I had expected due to a combination of inefficient coding practices, unexpected complications, and a lack of experience with the platform I was using. When I realized I wouldn’t be able to reach my goal in the allotted time, I reorganized my schedule to maximize efficiency and took steps to thoroughly investigate any issues that arose.
